article.title: Microsoft Advertising更新自動競價，建議先核對轉換訊號
article.summary: Microsoft Advertising開始推出自動競價模型更新，並建議廣告主先檢查轉換追蹤和交易價值。
highlights: 平台表示，新模型可更快回應CPA或ROAS目標的調整。
轉換訊號可由UET網站追蹤、Conversions API或離線匯入提供。
article.why: 成效團隊可先確認追蹤能否把實際銷售價值傳回平台，再評估以轉換數或價值作競價目標。
article.next_step: 檢查主要轉換的重複計算、幣別及交易金額，再按活動目標選擇競價策略。
article.detail: Microsoft在公告中解釋，自動競價須先有可用的轉換訊號。平台建議，若以交易價值為目標，應提供實際購買金額。公司亦介紹讓應用程式、客戶管理系統和門市等資料透過Conversions API傳回平台的方法。廣告團隊可以抽查一批訂單，逐筆核對後台銷售與平台記錄，找出漏報或重複計算。
article.title_en: Microsoft Advertising updates automated bidding and points to conversion signals
article.summary_en: Microsoft Advertising began rolling out updated bidding models and urged advertisers to check conversion tracking and transaction values.
highlights_en: The platform says the models can respond faster to changes in CPA or ROAS targets.
Conversion signals can come from UET website tracking, Conversions API or offline imports.
article.why_en: Performance teams can check whether actual sales values reach the platform before choosing to optimize for conversion count or value.
article.next_step_en: Audit duplicates, currencies and transaction amounts in primary conversions before selecting a bidding strategy.
article.detail_en: Microsoft explains that automated bidding needs usable conversion signals and recommends actual purchase amounts for value-based campaigns. Its Conversions API can bring in signals from apps, customer systems and stores. Teams can reconcile a sample of orders against their sales records to identify missing or duplicate events.
